newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Telemig maintained as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telemig maintained as buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers Inc and its local associate Banco Patrimonio said they reiterated their buy recommendation on Brazilian telecoms operator Telemig .
-- They also said they maintained earnings forecasts for the firm, a unit of federal holding Telebras serving Minas Gerais state.
-- In a report, Patrimonio analyst Ricardo Gurman said Telemig's first first-half financial results "were above estimates, both operationally and financially speaking."
-- "Until we get more details to revise our model, we are maintaining our 1997 and 1998 estimates of 344 million reais 429 million reais, respectively," he wrote.
-- Telemig reported a 127 million net incoome in the second quarter compared with the 58 million in second quarter 1996and 73 million reais in first-quarter 1997.
-- Telemig common was flat at 174 reais while its preferred B share was up 6.49 percent at 197 reais at 1225 local/1525 GMT in Sao Paulo.
